profile.title: AI/ML Engineer & Full‑Stack Developer | Automation & Security Specialist
profile.tagline: Building intelligent systems that automate, connect, and ship – with security at the core.
profile.philosophy: I build systems that think, connect, and ship. With a security aware mindset.
profile.bio: I design and build security‑aware AI systems, automation workflows, and full‑stack applications. Since January 2026, I’ve trained Small Language Models (SLMs), deployed production web apps, and co‑founded two startups. Currently, I’m a Machine Learning Intern at FlyRank, working on AI agents and production ML. I also lead the TRI AI team (Google DeepMind) building an SLM on African folktales, and I’m a Team Lead for the TechCrush Cybersecurity Bootcamp capstone. Through Kaizora Academy, I teach practical AI automation to aspiring builders. I ship what I start — and I make sure it’s secure.
profile.metaDescription: Chisom Okafor – AI/ML Engineer, Full‑Stack Developer, and Automation Specialist. Building secure, production‑ready systems with SLMs, Python, and security-first design.

projects.description: Developed an interactive Rock‑Paper‑Scissors game using Python logic and a responsive HTML/CSS frontend. Players compete against the computer with live score tracking and instant feedback – a practical showcase of frontend‑backend integration.

projects.description: Built a small language model from scratch as part of TRI AI (Google DeepMind). Trained and evaluated an SLM end‑to‑end using PyTorch, with a focus on African folktales.

projects.name: Scholar Bridge – Scholarship Matching Platform
